description: Estimate a maximum purchase price from gross monthly income, monthly debts, and a DTI target (default 45 for VA and FHA, 41 for conventional and jumbo). Returns the payment at that price. Read-only. No personal identifiers.

creditScore.description: Optional FICO for conventional PMI. Omit it to use LTV-only PMI tiers. Do not send a name or SSN.

dtiTarget.description: Housing-plus-debts DTI cap as a percent. Defaults to 45 for VA and FHA, 41 for conventional and jumbo.

grossMonthlyIncome.description: Gross monthly income in dollars. Do not send a name or employer.

hoaMonthly.description: HOA or maintenance fee in dollars per month.

insuranceMonthly.description: Homeowner's insurance in dollars per month. Default $150 is a planning placeholder, not a quote.

monthlyDebts.description: Monthly debt payments already owed (car, cards, student loans).

monthlyTaxOverride.description: Monthly property tax in dollars. A value above 0 replaces the tax-rate calculation.

propertyTaxRatePercent.description: Annual property tax as a percent of price. Default 0.35 is Honolulu County residential.

rate.description: Annual note rate as a percent. Default 6.5 is an example, not a quote.

vaDisabilityExempt.description: True if the borrower is exempt from the VA funding fee.

vaFirstUse.description: VA funding fee: true = first use. Ignored for other loan types.
